controles.affirmation: Haemonetics a depose plainte en juillet 2025 contre Fresenius Kabi USA pour contrefacon de trois brevets, plainte etendue en octobre 2025 a Fresenius Kabi AG et Fenwal Inc, reponse en mars 2026 avec demandes reconventionnelles
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026, note 18 : "In July 2025, Haemonetics Corporation filed a lawsuit against Fresenius Kabi USA in the Northern District of Illinois alleging infringement of three patents related to plasma collection systems. In October 2025, Haemonetics filed an amended complaint adding Fresenius Kabi AG and Fenwal, Inc. as additional defendants... In March 2026, Fresenius Kabi USA and Fresenius Kabi AG filed their response including counterclaims for declaratory judgment that Haemonetics' asserted patents are invalid and / or not infringed."

controles.affirmation: Le site de Melrose Park (Illinois) a recu de la FDA une classification "Official Action Indicated" pouvant restreindre la production
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026 : "the Fresenius Kabi site in Melrose Park, Illinois, received an FDA classification indicating deficiencies that may result in potential regulatory follow-up actions (\"Official Action Indicated\"). Potential restrictions or delays at affected sites may have a negative effect on the assets, liabilities, financial position and financial performance of the Fresenius Group."

controles.affirmation: Enquete preliminaire de l'autorite espagnole de la concurrence chez Fresenius Kabi, sans investigation formelle ouverte contre la societe ; aucun effet negatif significatif attendu
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026 : "including a preliminary inquiry at Fresenius Kabi initiated by the Spanish competition authority regarding certain healthcare industry practices. The Company has exercised its procedural rights in connection with these matters. The proceeding remains preliminary, and no formal investigation into the Company has been opened. Although the outcome of such matters cannot be predicted, none is currently expected to have a material adverse effect..."

controles.affirmation: Loi de stabilisation des cotisations adoptee le 10 juillet 2026, entree en vigueur au 1er janvier 2027, limitations sur le tarif de base DRG et ajustements du budget des soins infirmiers, incertitudes sur la mise en oeuvre
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026, note 23 Subsequent Events : "The act to stabilize contribution rates in statutory health insurance in Germany (GKV-Beitragssatzstabilisierungsgesetz) was adopted on July 10, 2026, with its key provisions becoming effective on January 1, 2027. The measures include, among other things, interventions in the hospital reimbursement framework in Germany, particularly limitations on DRG base rate increases to the basic wage rate as well as adjustments to the nursing care budget. Uncertainties remain regarding the detailed design and phased implementation of the respective provisions."

controles.affirmation: 130 M€ decaisses depuis la cloture de la transaction Vamed/VIACAMA, passif financier de 71 M€ au 30 juin 2026 exigible jusqu'en 2027, garanties bancaires de plusieurs centaines de millions d'euros
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026 : "the Fresenius Group has disbursed €130 million since the closing of the transaction and recognized a financial liability of €71 million as of June 30, 2026, which will be cash-effective in future periods until 2027. The Fresenius Group also holds bank guarantees for performance commitments in connection with the divested international project business in the low-three-digit million euro range."

controles.affirmation: Goodwill 14 655 M€ au 30 juin 2026 (35% de 41 844 M€ de total de bilan), en hausse de 128 M€ depuis fin 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport semestriel S1 2026, bilan : "Goodwill 14,655 14,527" ; "Total assets 41,844 41,395" ; note 11 : "Carrying amount as of December 31, 2025 ... 14,527 / Foreign currency translation 128 -- 0 128 / Carrying amount as of June 30, 2026 ... 14,655"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la hausse de 128 M€ provient integralement des ecarts de conversion, pas d'acquisitions nouvelles ; le preciser eviterait une lecture trompeuse.

controles.affirmation: La fondation Else Kroner-Fresenius-Stiftung detient 27,1% du capital et controle le commandite Fresenius Management SE
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel URD FY2025 : "The Else Kroner-Fresenius-Stiftung was the largest shareholder of Fresenius & SE & Co. KGaA, with 27.1% of the shares."

controles.affirmation: Aux Etats-Unis, Fresenius Kabi vend une large part de ses produits a un nombre restreint d'acheteurs ; tarifs douaniers americains sur les importations depuis la Suisse, l'Inde, l'UE et la Chine ; "some negative impact from U.S. tariffs"
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "many of these products are sold exclusively through a limited number of buyers, especially in the United States, which creates a special dependency on these customers" ; "the Group is provisionally expecting additional customs expenses for imports from key production countries such as Switzerland, India..." ; Communique T1 2026 : "The performance in the quarter also reflected the targeted ramp-up of R&D spending, mainly at Biopharma, and some negative impact from U.S. tariffs."

controles.affirmation: Guidance BPA courant relevee de 5-10% a 10-15% ; marge EBIT groupe 12,3% au T2 ; dette nette/EBITDA a 2,6x ; Kabi Pharma 935 M€ sur 2 244 M€ (42%), -1,3% ; Helios Allemagne 2 096 M€
